title: Epistemic Gap Diagnosis
description: Validates the deterministic diagnosis output of the gap diagnosis engine. Each finding cites a gap code from data/research-os/gap-codes.json, supplies evidence, severity, the affected claim/obligation, and candidate correcting actions. The engine must not rely on regex-only classification of free prose as its primary capability.

evidence.description: Concrete evidence for the finding; not a regex match alone.

affected.description: Affected claim id, obligation id or episode.

correcting_actions.description: Action codes from the action vocabulary.

detection_method.description: How the gap was detected (structured inspection, not free-text regex).
